title: The Best Home Saunas To Turn Your Home Into a Relaxing Spa
summary: It’s time to put yourself first. Shop the best outdoor, indoor and portable saunas for your home.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

You don’t have to leave home to enjoy a perfectly relaxing spa day, just get a home sauna.

At-home sweat lodges can come in handy when you need to relax after a long day or an intense workout. If the idea of buying a home sauna feels intimidating or overwhelming, it’s not as daunting as you may believe. In fact, you don’t need a ton of space to fit one comfortably in your home and there are several options on sale throughout the web.

What is the best home sauna overall? The Sun Home Saunas Equinox is our best overall pick because of its mix of heating types, premium design, chromotherapy lighting, EMF/ELF blocking technology and range of features for beginners and experienced users alike. We also like its competitive price.

See below for more information on possible benefits of home saunas and brands that we recommend.

Here’s What Makes Home Saunas Worth It

Getting in a sauna for your home means that you’re putting health and wellness first. Aside from stress and pain relief, saunas may offer a range of possible health benefits. Sauna use has been studied for potential cardiovascular, circulation, relaxation, and recovery-related benefits, though results can vary by sauna type and individual health factors. A home sauna should not be treated as a weight-loss treatment, anti-aging cure, or substitute for medical care.

“A home sauna gives your heart a workout without moving a muscle,” says Dr. Tania Elliott, MD to Billboard . “Dilates your blood vessels increasing blood flow to your heart and brain. Reduces risk of heart attack and stroke. It also improves skin texture by increasing blood flow to your skin, hello sauna glow.”

People who are pregnant, have heart or blood pressure concerns, are sensitive to heat, or take medications that may affect hydration, sweating, dizziness, or heat tolerance should consult a clinician before using a sauna regularly.”

And you can use them indoors or outdoors, including in the backyard, basement, home gym or a large bathroom. Not all saunas are created equally, though, so while you might find some for under $500 such as this lightweight steam sauna on Amazon , they won’t be as sturdy and don’t look as good as wooden saunas from retailers, such as Sun Home Saunas, Amazon, Wayfair and others.

BEST OVERALL

Sun Home Saunas Equinox

$6,799

Buy Now At Sun Home Saunas

Best for: Two-person infrared use
Capacity: 2 people
Max temperature: 120°F
Heat type: FAR-Infrared, Full-spectrum
Best placement: Indoor
Why we chose it: Premium design, six heaters, chromotherapy lighting, and EMF/ELF blocking technology

The sauna has a 4.8 out of 5 star shopper reviews, while it’s one of the models that appeals to most people. Meanwhile, the sauna reaches up to 120-degrees, while it’s made from solid wood (like all Sun Home Saunas). Equinox boasts a sleek, two-toned design with an integrated full-spectrum infrared heating system at home instead of the spa.

“At home you have more control of the settings,” continues Dr. Elliott on the possible benefits home saunas. “you can go ‘au naturale,’ so don’t have to worry about hygiene and sweating in synthetic clothing. You don’t need to sit in someone else’s sweat or rely on a facilities cleaning practices.” 

The indoor sauna features six heaters, including four FAR-infrared heaters, as well as two full-spectrum infrared heaters. Additional features include chromotherapy LED lighting to promote rejuvenation and low-EMF/ELF design intended to reduce electromagnetic-field exposure

“Traditional saunas have dry heat that heats the circulating air and goes through your core body temperature. Think of it like a convection oven,” Dr. Elliott describes. “Infrared sauna directly heats the skin.”

BEST FOR OUTDOORS

Sun Home Saunas Luminar

$11,599

Buy Now Sun Home

Best for: Two-person infrared use and smartphone connectivity
Max temperature: 170°F
Best placement: Indoor, Outdoor
Why we chose it: Premium design, 15 heaters and chromotherapy lighting, smartphone connectivity

If you’re looking to enjoy a beautiful view of the outdoors while relaxing in a state-of-the art, smart sauna — the Sun Home Saunas Luminar is a great choice. The smart sauna brings the outdoors inside, by way of a double-pane, glass exterior. It’s made from other premium materials, including aerospace-grade aluminum and red cedar wood for durability and stability with chromotherapy lighting. It features 15 heaters — 10 full spectrum heaters and five FAR-infrared heaters – that are placed all over the sauna to heat from every direction for a better sweat for deeper relaxation.

But, the biggest selling point is its built-in smartphone connectivity with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity. In fact, you can control the temperature and settings with its mobile app. It even includes premium Bluetooth speakers with premium surround sound to sync your smartphone for streaming your favorite music and podcasts from various music apps — which can give you a “calming, relaxing effect,” says Dr. Elliott.

BEST FOR GROUPS

Redwood Barrel Sauna

$6,299

Buy Now on Redwood Outdoor

Best for: Six-person steam use
Capacity: 6 people
Max temperature: 195°F
Heat type: Steam
Best placement: Outdoor
Why we chose it: Classic design, electric Harvia KIP heaters, Wi-Fi controls

What is the best outdoor sauna for groups? The Redwood Barrel Sauna is our pick best home sauna for groups because of its sturdy and durable barrel-shaped design that features Finnish-made Harvia’s electric Harvia KIP heater for intense heat and steam. It raises temperatures slowly and steadily to create a deep and calming atmosphere for better relaxation when getting a good sweat, especially for groups up to six people.

The sauna achieves this with its premium materials, including heat-treated Hemlock wood heater guards and tempered glass. It also comes with sauna rocks, a water bucket, ladle and plenty of seating, while the Redwood Outdoors sauna heats up to 195-degrees. The sauna requires 240-volts of dedicated power in your home.

The barrel sauna features digital Wi-Fi and manual heating controls, which you can preheat up to eight hours in advance. The exterior of the sauna measures about six feet high and six feet wide, while it weighs around 900 pounds, while it’s surprisingly easy to assemble with its included sauna kit. The Redwood Barrel Sauna is a standout in design, as a centerpiece in a backyard, or apartment building rooftop.

BEST ENTRY-LEVEL PICK

Dynamic Saunas Barcelona

What is the best affordable home sauna? The Dynamic Saunas Barcelona is our pick for best affordable home sauna because it’s a model that comfortably fits two people at once, boasts low EMF FAR infrared sauna with red light therapy and it’s at a great affordable price. Made from strong natural Canadian hemlock wood with six dynamic low EMF carbon PureTech infrared panels. It also uses red light therapy for calming and soothing chromotherapy lighting, while the sauna heats up impressively fast with temperatures up to 130 degree Fahrenheit, while it has energy consumption setting to save you some power usage and money.
